# Dropcue

> Dropcue helps creators sell digital products and deliver files securely after payment.

## Public pages

- [Home](/): Product overview and creator workflow.
- [How it works](/how-it-works): Upload, price, share, and deliver digital products.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Dropcue pricing information.
- [Security](/security): Product security and delivery protections.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): Data collection, processing, retention, and rights.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): Terms governing use of Dropcue.

## Public machine-readable resources

- [Robots](/robots.txt): Crawler policy and sitemap discovery.
- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): Public canonical URLs.
- [Security contact](/.well-known/security.txt): Responsible disclosure instructions.

## Product capabilities

Dropcue supports creator authentication, digital product uploads, hosted checkout, payment webhooks, secure expiring download links, transactional email, and creator order tracking.

## Privacy

The application uses essential authentication and session cookies. Product files are stored privately and served through signed URLs after payment verification.
